name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned (self) -> T where T : Sized ,
rule: A pointer to an unaligned packed struct field constructed using `&raw const` may be used as `self` in `read_unaligned`, provided it is valid for reads and points to a properly initialized value of type `T`.
